charts.title: Social media advertising spending worldwide from 2019 to 2029 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Social media ad spend worldwide 2019-2029
charts.description: The global ad spending in the 'Social Media Advertising' segment of the advertising market was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2029 by in total 111.6 billion U.S. dollars (+47.66 percent). After the tenth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 345.73 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2029. Notably, the ad spending of the 'Social Media Advertising' segment of the advertising market was continuously increasing over the past years.
charts.note: 2019 to 2029; Includes paid advertising appearing within social networks, social network games and social network applications; excludes spending by marketers that goes toward developing or maintaining a social network presence

charts.title: Social network advertising spending per user worldwide from 2020 to 2028, by device (in U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Social network ad spending per user worldwide 2020-2028, by device
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the ad spending is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. As part of the positive trend, the indicator reaches the maximum value for all two different segments at the end of the comparison period. Particularly noteworthy is the segment Social Media Advertising Mobile, which has the highest value of 212,684,584,054.29 U.S. dollars.
charts.note: 2020 to 2028; Includes paid advertising appearing within social networks, social network games and social network applications; excludes spending by marketers that goes toward developing or maintaining a social network presence

charts.title: Leading markets worldwide in 2022, by social media advertising spending (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Largest social media advertising markets worldwide 2022
charts.description: Comparing the 20 selected regions regarding the ad spending in the 'Social Media Advertising' segment of the digital advertising market, the United States is leading the ranking (66.6 billion U.S. dollars) and is followed by China with 64.6 billion U.S. dollars. At the other end of the spectrum is Thailand with 457.91 million U.S. dollars, indicating a difference of 66.2 billion U.S. dollars to the United States.
charts.note: Worldwide; Jan 1st to Dec 31st 2022
charts.source: Statista; Statista Digital Market Insights Spending in million U.S. dollars

charts.title: Volume of social media advertising spending worldwide from 2nd quarter 2022 to 3rd quarter 2023 (indexed to 2nd quarter 2022)
charts.short: Social media ad spend growth worldwide 2021-2022
charts.description: In all three quarters between the third quarter of 2022 and the first quarter of 2023, social media advertising spending worldwide was higher than in the second quarter of 2022. In the second quarter of 2023, it was four percent lower than in the base quarter.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q2 2022 to Q2 2023

charts.title: Expected change in digital media budgets worldwide in 2024, by format
charts.short: Growth of digital media budgets worldwide 2024, by format
charts.description: During a survey published in November 2023, 25 percent of responding global brands stated they were planning to significantly increase their retail media budgets in 2023. Another 35 percent said they were planning to slightly increase them.
charts.note: Worldwide; as of November 2023
charts.source: Ebiquity; Statista; World Federation of Advertisers Share of respondents

charts.title: Change in advertising revenue of selected social media platforms worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Growth of social media ad revenue worldwide 2023, by platform
charts.description: Advertising revenue generated by TikTok was expected to increase by 55 percent in 2023. That would make it the fastest-growing social media platform among the seven market leaders presented in the data set. As of August 2023, X's (Twitter's) ad revenue was expected to shrink by 30 percent in that calendar year.
charts.note: Worldwide; August 2023; forecast

charts.title: Social media analytics market size worldwide from 2021 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Social media analytics market value worldwide 2021-2028
charts.description: In 2021, the global social media analytics market was valued at roughly seven billion U.S. dollars. It was expected to grow to 8.5 billion in 2022 and surpass 26 billion dollars in 2028. Social media analytics tools are used, among others, to manage customer experience, as well as marketing management, and to gain competitive intelligence.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2021; * Forecast. An exponential development of the values was assumed to estimate the annual values between 2021 and 2028, which were provided by the source. Read more

charts.title: Leading social media platforms used by marketers worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Social media platforms used by marketers worldwide 2023
charts.description: As of January 2023, Facebook was the most commonly used social media platform among marketers worldwide. According to a global survey, 89 percent of responding social media marketers used the network to promote their business, while another 80 percent did so via Instagram.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 2,133 respondents

charts.title: Frequency of social media ad use among marketers worldwide as of January 2023, by platform
charts.short: Use of social media ads among marketers worldwide 2023, by platform
charts.description: During a 2023 survey, 67 percent of responding marketers from across the world stated they often or sometimes used Facebook ads in their work. According to the results of this survey, Facebook was the most used ad platform. Instagram ranked second, with 52 percent of respondents saying they often or sometimes used ads on this platform.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 2,133 marketers; most participants were based in the USA, Canada, the UK, India, and Australia

charts.title: Planned changes in use of selected social media for marketing purposes worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Future use of social media among marketers worldwide 2023, by platform
charts.description: During a global 2023 survey, 66 percent of responding marketers stated they would increase their usage of Instagram in the near future; 43 percent said they would increase the usage of TikTok advertising, but as many as 45 percent were not planning to use the mobile video sharing app for marketing purposes.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 2,133 marketers

charts.title: Planned changes in use of selected video platforms for social media marketing purposes worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Future use of video among social media marketers worldwide 2023, by platform
charts.description: During a global survey of social media marketers released in 2023, 56 percent of responding industry professionals stated they would increase their video activities on Instagram in the following 12 months, while 59 percent said they planned to do so on YouTube.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2023; 2,133 respondents; among marketers

charts.title: Areas in which marketers used automation the most worldwide as of February 2024
charts.short: Areas in which marketers used automation the most worldwide 2024
charts.description: During a February 2024 global survey among marketing decision-makers, approximately 58 percent reported automating their email marketing efforts. Social media and content management followed, as respectively 49 and 33 percent of respondents said they used automation in those areas.
charts.note: Worldwide; February 2024; 387 respondents; among marketing decision-makers

charts.title: Leading digital consumer engagement tactics according to marketers worldwide as of June 2022
charts.short: Leading digital consumer engagement tactics worldwide 2022
charts.description: During a 2022 survey carried out among marketing leaders worldwide, 89 percent of respondents stated they used pre-produced videos as a digital consumer engagement tactic. Another 89 percent were also relying on the livestream video format as a digital engagement technique. User-generated content (UGC) was used by 68 percent of global marketers in their online engagement efforts.
charts.note: Worldwide; June 30 to August 8, 2022; 6,000 respondents; among full-time marketing leaders from B2B, B2C, and B2B2C companies

charts.title: Leading benefits of using social media for marketing purposes worldwide as of January 2023
charts.short: Benefits of social media marketing worldwide 2023
charts.description: Increased exposure is the most commonly cited advantage of using social media for marketing purposes among global industry professionals. This is unsurprising given the huge appeal of having billions of active users as a potential advertising audience. Improved traffic, lead generation and growing fan loyalty are further reasons why marketers see value in employing social networks in their campaigns. Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn are the top three most used social platforms [...]
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2022; 2,133 respondents; 55% of the participants live in the US, 5% in the UK, 5% in Canada, 4% in India and 3% in Australia. For 43% of marketers surveyed, social media is their primary responsibility. And 63% of marketers work in B2C, 37% in B2B.

charts.title: Most effective digital advertising formats for mobile app user acquisition according to app developers worldwide as of 2nd quarter 2022
charts.short: Most effective ad formats for mobile app user acquisition worldwide 2022
charts.description: According to a 2022 survey of app developers worldwide, full-screen video ads were considered the most effective ads to acquire new app users, with 51 percent of respondents signaling this format. Social video ads ranked second, with 46 percent of respondents reporting them as the most effective ad formats for app user acquisition. In-feed video ads ranked third, with 41 percent of app developers finding them effective to gain new users.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q1 and Q2 2022; 142 respondents; among app developers, publishers, and marketers

charts.title: Volume of social media advertising impressions worldwide from 4th quarter 2022 to 4th quarter 2023 (indexed to 4th quarter 2022)
charts.short: Volume of social media ad impressions worldwide 2022-2023
charts.description: In the fourth quarter of 2023, the volume of social media ad impressions was 324 percent higher than in the fourth quarter of 2022. It was also the quarter with the highest difference compared to the fourth quarter of 2022 in the presented period.
charts.note: Worldwide

charts.title: Volume of social media advertising clicks worldwide from 2nd quarter 2022 to 2nd quarter 2023 (indexed to 2nd quarter 2022)
charts.short: Volume of social media ad clicks worldwide 2022-2023
charts.description: In the fourth quarter of 2022, the volume of social media ad impressions was 54 percent higher than in the second quarter of 2022. In the last presented quarter, the volume was 35 percent higher than during the second quarter of 2022.
charts.note: Worldwide

charts.title: Social media advertising clickthrough rate (CTR) worldwide from 4th quarter 2022 to 4th quarter 2023
charts.short: Social media ads CTR worldwide 2022-2023
charts.description: Recent evaluation of social media advertising metrics shows that the click-through rate (CTR) for social networks in the fourth quarter of 2023 reached 0.98 percent. A quarter earlier, it stood at 0.92 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q4 2022 to Q4 2023

charts.title: Social media advertising cost-per-mille (CPM) worldwide from 4th quarter 2022 to 4th quarter 2023 (in U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Social media ads CPM worldwide 2022-2023
charts.description: The cost-per-mille of advertising on social media was 6.06 U.S. dollars in the fourth quarter of 2023. In other words, advertisers had to pay this much to have their ads viewed by a thousand potential customers. Social media CPM is usually higher in the final quarters of each year. The surge in costs is prompted by increased demand for advertising space during that time, as brands compete to win over prospective clients.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q4 2022 to Q4 2023

charts.title: Leading media and entertainment brands worldwide in 2023, by brand value (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Most valuable media & entertainment brands worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, Google ranked as the most valuable media and entertainment brand worldwide, with a brand value of nearly 537.2 billion U.S. dollars. Facebook ranked second, valued at around 93 billion dollars. Part of the Tencent Group, WeChat and v.qq.com (Tencent Video) had a brand value of 53.5 billion and 19.5 billion dollars, respectively.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2023
charts.source: Kantar Brand value in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Brands with the highest brand value change worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Fastest growing brands worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, Airtel was the fastest growing brand worldwide. The Indian telecom provider registered an annual brand value growth of 24 percent. Pepsi ranked second, with a growth rate of 17 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2023

charts.title: Digital advertising revenues of major internet companies worldwide in 2023 and 2027 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Digital advertising revenue for major internet companies 2023-2027
charts.description: In 2023, the forecast for Facebook digital advertising revenues saw the Meta company generating 119 billion U.S. dollars by the end of the fiscal year. TikTok was projected to see its online advertising revenues hit 18 billion U.S. dollars. By comparison, LinkedIn advertising revenues were forecasted to reach approximately a third of that amount for 2023.
charts.note: Worldwide; August 2023; forecast
charts.source: Statista; Various sources Revenue in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Social media platforms with the largest return on investment (ROI) according to marketers worldwide as of September 2023
charts.short: Social media platforms with highest ROI worldwide 2023
charts.description: According to a survey released in September 2023 and conducted among B2B and B2C marketers worldwide 29 percent of respondents said that Facebook was the social media platform with the highest return on investment (ROI) that year. The same share of respondents pointed towards Instagram for the same reason. YouTube ranked third with 26 percent of respondents, followed by TikTok with 24 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; as of September 2023; 1,460 respondents; among global marketers from across B2B and B2C companies

charts.title: Share of shoppers that purchased a product after seeing it on social media in selected countries worldwide in 2nd quarter 2023
charts.short: Consumers who bought an item after seeing it on social media 2023, by country
charts.description: In a 2023 survey, approximately 58 percent of shoppers in the United States said they had at some point purchased a product after seeing it on a social media platform. On the other hand, in the United Kingdom and Germany, 44 percent and 40 percent of respondents, respectively, said they bought something after spotting it on social networks.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q2 2023; 19,293 respondents; 18 years and older; purchases made in the previous month

charts.title: Millennials' opinions on how much they trust product/brand recommendations made by social media influencers worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Millennials' trust on product/brand recommendation made by influencers worldwide 2023
charts.description: As of March 2023, nearly 50 percent of 10 millennials worldwide found influencers' recommendations of a brand or product more engaging than regular advertisements. For 36 percent of the respondents, influencer recommendations were also considered more trustworthy than average ads. According to the same report, millennials ranked reliability as the most wanted quality in a brand.
charts.note: Worldwide; March 2023; 3,700 respondents; 27-40 years; in 12 markets

charts.title: Importance of social media as a fashion information source for luxury consumers in selected countries/regions worldwide as of May 2022
charts.short: Social media as a fashion information source for luxury consumers worldwide 2022
charts.description: During a 2022 survey carried out among luxury consumers, 65 percent of respondents from China stated that social media was an important source of fashion-related information. The same was true for 24 percent of respondents from Italy and 38 percent of respondents from the United States.
charts.note: Worldwide; April and May 2022; 5,647 respondents
